basic_info.description: PRICE REDUCED!! Elegance abounds in this luxury PENTHOUSE level condo with gorgeous VIEWS via floor-to-ceiling windows and private balcony. This centrally located light filled unit combines the elements of contemporary design with exceptional functionality. The modern European Chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry and backsplash, white quartz counters, and high-end European appliances. The open floorplan is ideal for entertaining guests while enjoying the ample light and breath-taking views. The primary bedroom features a lavish ensuite bathroom featuring a dual vanity and designer tiles. Luxurious features include wide plank oak flooring, custom motorized window coverings, central heat and A/C, in-unit washer/dryer, and custom-built closet organizer systems. One car parking spot and an additional private storage complete this unit. Enjoy added security and ease of access with the keyless Latch Entry system throughout the building. The massive roof top deck features an outdoor kitchen facility and is perfect for entertaining guests or simply relaxing and taking in the panoramic views. Endless entertainment & eating options steps from home in vibrant Mission neighborhood: Foreign Cinema, Mission Dolores Park, Tartine,& many more. Easy access to Freeway, BART & transportation
